answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 1056 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is my son a mahram to my brother's wife? Question: Assalaamu 'alaikum Is my son a mahram to my brother's wife? JazakAllah. Answer ID: 1056 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim !
